args.title: Partial refunds API
args.content: Started the partial refunds endpoint. The admin screen sends a list of order_item ids; the API sums their prices in pence, checks the total against the remaining capture and calls POST /v2/payments/{id}/partial-refunds. Sandbox refunds only work on payments from yesterday, so the tests use a fixture payment dated the day before. Next: the item picker in the admin screen.
